# IngredientDraftExporter

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class IngredientDraftExporter
```

Turns an [`IngredientDraft`](Nfty.Core.Editing.IngredientDraft.md) into the pair the existing [`IngredientArchive`](Nfty.Core.Formats.IngredientArchive.md) writes: a manifest plus one live image per variant id. Callers own the returned images.

## Remarks

[`IngredientDraft.Kind`](Nfty.Core.Editing.IngredientDraft.md#p-kind) alone decides which raster a variant exports — its [`VariantDraft.Color`](Nfty.Core.Editing.VariantDraft.md#p-color) for Custom, its [`VariantDraft.Map`](Nfty.Core.Editing.VariantDraft.md#p-map) for Dynamic and Static. A variant painted in color still holds both, so reading "whichever is non-null" would quietly export color art from a value-map layer and destroy the layer's color space.

```csharp
public static (IngredientManifest, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Image<Rgba32>>) Export(IngredientDraft draft);
```

Turns a draft into the manifest and images an `.igt` is written from.

**Parameters**

- `draft` (`IngredientDraft`) - The draft to export.

**Returns.** The manifest and one image per variant; the caller owns the images.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException` - Two variants share an id, or a Custom variant has no color raster to write.
